subject: Re: Xcelerate - delivery window alignment for tenant-export requirement
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@xcelerate.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant-export requirement and contractual delivery window

Hi Sean / Ben,

Quick heads-up from our side: legal and security have added a hard line item to our SOC2 readiness checklist — we need a per-tenant audit/export capability (exportable event stream + config isolation) in our production environment. Our board has set a go/no-go for the audit on 2027-07-20 and procurement requires a committed delivery window in the SOW.

Can Redwood commit to a delivery date (or an acceptable staged delivery plan) by EOD Wednesday (2027-06-30)? We need the delivery window in writing for our sign-off.

I attached the updated SOW (SOW_v3) with the clause highlighted. Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Soto
Head of IT Compliance, Xcelerate Corp
--Attachment: Xcelerate_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf, 198KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@xcelerate.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant-export requirement and contractual delivery window

Hi Elena — thanks for the clarity and the SOW. Looping in Product (Maya) and Eng (Jonas) to confirm scope and feasibility.

Internal ask for @Maya / @Jonas:
- Can we scope a minimal deliverable that satisfies an auditable per-tenant export (events + config) and ship as a staged item?
- If staged: what are earliest realistic dates for a narrow-scope "export shim" vs. a full-feature implementation with tenant isolation and observability?
- Any blocking hotspots (data model changes, infra routing, compliance review)?

Elena — we aim to provide a written delivery plan by EOD Wednesday; will confirm ASAP but need product/eng input to firm dates.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.com | +1 650-555-0198

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant-export requirement and contractual delivery window

Thanks for the ping, Sean. Quick assessment below (high-level — want to avoid overpromising). Attached are brief impact notes.

Summary and tradeoffs:
- Narrow-scope shim (audit export only): implement an export endpoint that can pull per-tenant event slices and redact sensitive fields. No tenant-specific runtime isolation. Estimated delivery: 2027-07-26 (T+28 days). Risks: won't satisfy isolation requirements if audit looks for runtime separation; easier QA and lower infra lift.
- Full isolation implementation: tenant-level routing + dedicated KV/cache partitioning + end-to-end telemetry. Estimated delivery: 2027-08-12 (T+45 days) if we prioritize and allocate a small eng pod. Risks: larger QA window and potential infra sequencing with infra team's upcoming maintenance.
- Blocking items: final schema confirmation (simple), storage ACLs (infra change), and legal review for the export payload contract language (we can draft).

Ask for sales/CS: decide if Xcelerate will accept a staged deliverable (shim by 7/26 + full by 8/12). If customer needs a single committed date for the SOW, the only viable single date is 2027-08-12.

Jonas — engineering estimate assumes we can pull one mid-sized feature sprint and freeze other noncritical work for two weeks.

Maya Srinivasan
Head of Product, Redwood Inference
--Attachment: impact_notes_20270629.pdf (text/plain, 32KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@xcelerate.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant-export requirement and contractual delivery window

Elena — thanks and quick update from the product/eng side below; copying the short plan so you have language for procurement.

Proposed delivery plan (please confirm):
- Staged commitment:
  1) Audit-export shim (per-tenant export + field redaction) by 2027-07-26. This satisfies the auditing use-case for the July-20/board readiness timeline for the audit run (we will provide test evidence and a verification checklist).
  2) Full tenant isolation (routing + partitioned KV/cache + telemetry) by 2027-08-12.
- If Xcelerate requires a single hard delivery date in the SOW we recommend using 2027-08-12 and we will offer the shim as an interim deliverable (formal milestone in the SOW).

Call to action: Elena — can you confirm acceptance of the staged plan by EOD Thursday (2027-07-01)? If yes, Ben and I will update the SOW language to include the 7/26 milestone and the 8/12 final delivery date, plus acceptance criteria for the shim. If you prefer a single date, let us know and we'll mark 8/12 as the committed delivery.

Thanks — will standby for your decision and will draft SOW wording once we hear back.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
